label: GOD_1: the naming premise read nominally is analytic
description: GOD_1 (NOMINAL) branch of the naming use: read as what the name signifies, 'the fully described principle is God' needs no premise. Recorded as its own statement so that it cannot be taken for the GOD_4 root premise STMT-GOD-NAMES-THE-FULLY-DESCRIBED-PRINCIPLE, whose Lean declaration is generic in the God predicate.
